description:
About the company
 Our client is a technology company.
 The role
 Raydar is recruiting for this role on behalf of our client. Own and improve a production computer vision service running on embedded hardware, delivering performance and stability gains to a system already in use in the field. The work centers on tuning real-time video and model pipelines and partnering closely with hardware and systems colleagues.
 What you'll do
 - Re-architect and optimize an existing real-time perception service so it handles more video streams with better stability.
 - Evaluate and integrate faster, higher-performing models while keeping real-time performance on edge hardware.
 - Bring depth estimation capabilities onto embedded compute to support three-dimensional tracking.
 - Tune the video and inference stack on edge devices to get the most out of the hardware.
 - Work with hardware and systems engineers to ship perception improvements to deployed systems.
 Requirements 
 What we're looking for
 - 4 to 7 years of experience, with strong Python and C++ skills.
 - Hands-on experience building production perception or machine learning systems, beyond research work.
 - Familiarity with GPU-accelerated inference tooling and deployment on embedded edge devices.
 - Prior work applying computer vision within physical, hardware-based products.
 - Solid grasp of video pipelines and how camera feeds behave in real deployments.
 - Track record of taking vision models from development into live use, including object tracking across frames.
 - Ability to own system architecture at a senior level.
 - Self-directed working style with comfort collaborating across functions in a fast-moving startup.
 - Bachelor's or master's degree in computer science.
 Bonus points
 - Exposure to industries where reliability and safety are critical.
 Benefits 
 Compensation and benefits
 - Base salary: USD 220,000 to 270,000 per year
 - Equity
 - Health insurance
 - Retirement plan
 - Commuter benefits
 - Family planning benefits
 Location and work model
 - San Francisco, CA, United States
 - Hybrid, 4 days in office
 - Full-time
